title: Project Arsenal Governance Source Model
description: Machine-readable index of where governance facts are owned and what state role each carrying artifact plays. This schema constrains the source model itself; it does NOT carry domain values such as supported targets, schema versions, adapter versions, suite IDs, or capability lifecycle/evaluation state. The `notes` field on each artifact is non-authoritative explanatory metadata and MUST NOT be consulted for domain truth. See scripts/arsenal_governance.py for the closed vocabularies referenced here.

id.description: Stable identifier for this artifact inside the source model. Used as the owner key for facts.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the artifact. Glob patterns are not allowed at the artifact level; use path_pattern to address a family of files or directories.

path_pattern.description: Optional bounded glob pattern (e.g. 'arsenal/capabilities/*.json' or 'distribution/agent-skills/*'). Repository-relative, no traversal. Used to address a family of artifacts that all share ownership and state role; the pattern may match files or directories.

ownership.description: Closed ownership layer. The validator rejects any value not in the canonical vocabulary.

state_role.description: Closed state role. The validator rejects any value not in the canonical vocabulary.

materialization.description: Optional materialization mode. The validator rejects any value not in the canonical vocabulary.

owns_facts.description: Fact IDs whose owner is this artifact. The artifact's state_role tells what kind of representation those facts are (normative/derived/historical/narrative). Empty array allowed only for narrative or derived artifacts that do not own any fact.

notes.description: NON-AUTHORITATIVE explanatory metadata. Free-form human-readable comment. Validators, projections, and governance queries MUST NOT consult this field for domain truth. It exists purely for documentation and must not become the only machine-relevant source of mutable current state.

owner_artifact.description: The single artifact that owns this fact. Validation rejects a fact with more than one owner.

locator.description: Free-form locator inside the owner (e.g. 'lifecycle', 'targets', 'evaluation'). The validator may grep this string against the artifact body; it never carries the value itself.
